summary: Validated the new 'Éco mode' toggle on the SIRIUS HUD plus chat regression. All eco wiring works: button text toggles between 'MODE ÉCO' and 'MODE ÉCO : ACTIVÉ', root [data-testid=sirius-hud] gains/loses 'eco' class, localStorage key 'sirius_eco' is persisted ('1'/'0') and restored on reload. App stays functional with eco ON: reactor canvas visible, chat call returns a French Groq answer, demo state buttons still switch the SIRIUS state label. Backend pytest suite (5/5) still green.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js: ReactorCore reads `eco` via stateRef inside the draw loop (good - avoids RAF restart) but the useEffect cleanup only runs once at unmount; this is correct, just confirming the prop is propagated through stateRef.current.eco on every render (lines 75-79). Verified working.

App.js line 261-262: ecoMode useState initializer reads localStorage synchronously and a useEffect writes it back. Fine for this small flag, but on first mount it will write back '0' even if the key was never set, which is acceptable.

App.js: WebSocket to ws://localhost:8765 produces console errors in the cloud preview (expected, gracefully falls back to cloud). Consider gating the WS attempt with an env flag to silence the console noise in production preview.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (eco toggle + persistence + chat + demo states all pass)

seed_data_creation: None new this iteration (eco state is client-side localStorage).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Eco mode flag is stored at localStorage key 'sirius_eco' ('1'|'0') and applied as the CSS class 'eco' on the root div [data-testid=sirius-hud]. Button [data-testid=sirius-eco-btn] toggles between labels 'MODE ÉCO' and 'MODE ÉCO : ACTIVÉ'. The ReactorCore canvas (data-testid=sirius-reactor) reads the eco prop via a stateRef and lowers framerate / removes shadowBlur / skips the dense inner ring + 90 graduation ticks when eco is true. The /api/chat backend route is unchanged and still works (Groq llama-3.3-70b-versatile primary + Gemini fallback + SerpAPI search via French keywords). Test session_id pattern: 'TEST_<hex>' in MongoDB db.sirius_chats.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found this iteration. Eco mechanism (CSS class + canvas prop + localStorage persistence) is correctly wired end-to-end.
